title: CellState
description: Common L0/L1 read-model for a Probe Cell (worker or orchestrator), Issue #298 / Probe Cell Fabric. Built deterministically at read time from existing Trace/Evaluation/Shadow Result/Replay/Experiment references and the Cell/Role Card definitions -- it is never a separately cached table. health/quality/improvement/orchestration are the additive extension blocks: Sub 1 (#298) always returns this envelope with those blocks empty/null; Sub 2 (#299) fills `health`, Sub 6 (#302) fills `quality`, Sub 7 (#304) fills `improvement`, and Sub 4 (#301) fills `orchestration` for roster-bearing Cells. Every later sub-issue only ever adds fields inside an existing block or a new schema_version -- it never introduces a new top-level key outside this fixed envelope.

health.description: Filled by Sub 2 (#299) from traces/evaluation_results/shadow_results/replay_runs/experiments. All fields nullable/optional; absent or null means not-yet-observed, never a guessed value.

quality.description: Filled by Sub 6 (#302) from cell_quality_configs / cell_quality_audits / cell_intake_states. All fields nullable/optional; absent or null means no quality-sampling data exists yet for this Cell, never a guessed value.

improvement.description: Filled by Sub 7 (#304) from cell_improvements. All fields nullable/optional; absent or null means no improvement data exists yet for this Cell.

orchestration.description: Filled by Sub 4 (#301) for roster-bearing (orchestrator) Cells only; absent for worker Cells.
